title: Amazon CloudWatch Overview
description: Understand CloudWatch Logs, Metrics, Alarms, and how they monitor ASP.NET Core apps.

data.text: Amazon CloudWatch is a monitoring and observability service. It collects logs, metrics, and events from AWS resources and on-premises servers, giving you a unified view of your application health.

items: **Logs** — centralized log storage from apps, servers, and AWS services
**Metrics** — time-series data like CPU, memory, and request count
**Dashboards** — custom visualizations of metrics and logs

data.text: The CloudWatch Agent collects logs and metrics from EC2 instances and on-premises servers. For containerized apps, the AWS ECS agent integrates with CloudWatch automatically.

data.title: Structured logging
data.text: Use structured JSON logs in ASP.NET Core to make CloudWatch Logs Insights queries more powerful.

data.content:

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: CloudWatch centralizes logs and metrics from AWS services
Use alarms to detect and respond to issues automatically
The CloudWatch Agent extends monitoring to EC2 and on-premises
data.takeaway: CloudWatch turns distributed AWS resources into a single observable system for ASP.NET Core apps.
